routes.name: Residencia temporaria – Deportistas y artistas (art. 23 inc. f)

note: Argentina, read in the Migration Law (Ley Nº 25.871) as updated on the government's legal portal (argentina.gob.ar/normativa, with the substitutions of Decreto Nº 366/2025 in force from 29 May 2025) on 2026-10-30. Sportspeople and artists contracted for their speciality by people or companies working in the country get temporary residence for up to three years, extendable, with multiple entries; read as tied to the contracting party ('sponsor'). Native citizens of the Mercosur States Parties, Chile and Bolivia get two years, extendable (the National Directorate of Migration's Disposición 29.929/2004, quoted in the portal's note, extends it to all States Parties and Associates); the work it allows is read as any. Permanent residence is admission as such by the National Directorate of Migration of one intending to settle for good, who must show sufficient means and no criminal record. Where each is asked for (a consulate or the Directorate in Argentina) is in the regulation, not read, so 'either' is the game's reading. Fees, decision times, the years before permanence and naturalisation (Ley 346) aren't in this law and aren't written; the Directorate's own pages (argentina.gob.ar/interior/migraciones) weren't read.

sources.title: Ley Nº 25.871, Ley de Migraciones, texto actualizado
sources.said: f) Deportistas y artistas: contratados en razón de su especialidad por personas físicas o jurídicas que desarrollan actividades en el país. Podrá concederse un término de residencia de hasta tres (3) años, prorrogables, con entradas y salidas múltiples; ... l) Nacionalidad: Ciudadanos nativos de Estados Parte del MERCOSUR, Chile y Bolivia, con autorización para permanecer en el país por dos (2) años, prorrogables con entradas y salidas múltiples; ... debiendo considerarse incluidos a todos los Estados Parte y Asociados del MERCADO COMUN DEL SUR (MERCOSUR). ... Se considerará ‘residente permanente’ a todo extranjero que, con el propósito de establecerse definitivamente en el país, obtenga de la DIRECCIÓN NACIONAL DE MIGRACIONES una admisión en tal carácter.
